shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
Cooking is one of my favorite hobbies.
My family enjoys traveling to new places.
I often go for walks in the evening.
Listening to music helps me relax after work.
I like to try different types of cuisine at restaurants.
My friends and I often watch movies together on weekends.
I enjoy volunteering at local community events every year.
Keeping a journal helps me reflect on my daily experiences.
I believe that learning a new language opens many doors for opportunities.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to stay active?
Q3: How important do you think regular exercise is for a healthy lifestyle?
Q4: What advice would you give someone who wants to start exercising?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: Can you share a personal experience related to environmental conservation?
Q2: What do you think is the biggest challenge to protecting the environment today?
Q3: In your opinion, how can individuals make a difference in environmental issues?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone wanting to be more eco-friendly?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study methods.
questions: Q1: What study techniques have worked best for you in school?
Q2: Have you faced any difficulties in finding effective study methods?
Q3: How do you believe the right study method impacts academic performance?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone struggling with their study habits?
